behavior_constraints: Targets accept `pre_build` and `post_build` arrays of shell commands forming ordered hook chains
Pre-build hooks run in order before the main command; post-build hooks run after a successful main command
Hook failure stops the chain and fails the target immediately
All hooks and the main command share the target timeout as a single deadline
Hooks may export variables by printing lines `BUILDCTL_ENV:KEY=VALUE` to stdout
Exported KEY must match `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*`; malformed lines are silently ignored
Exports carry forward to subsequent hooks within the same chain
Pre-build exports feed into the main command's env and override same-named target `env` entries
Post-build hooks start from the target's base env only; pre-build exports do not carry into post-build
Cache key includes sorted dependency names and sorted output paths in addition to existing inputs
entities.summary: This round adds ordered pre/post-build hook chains with timeout sharing and `BUILDCTL_ENV` variable export semantics, and extends cache keys with sorted dependency names, sorted output paths, and the full hook arrays.

instruction_head:
Add pre/post build hooks and fix cache keys.

Targets gain `pre_build` and `post_build` -- each an array of shell commands forming a hook chain. Pre-hooks run in order before the main command; post-hooks run after a successful main command.
